trigger: User requested distributed IssueQueue architecture plus rv32 timeout debug

files_modified.notes: Added independent backend issue widths and WB_PORT_NUM.
Added distributed queue depths, payload index ranges, free count types, and global age field.
Split issue pop/free count interfaces into Int/Mem/Mul groups.
Replaced unified queue with wrapper plus IntIssueQueue and two strict in-order FIFO queues.
Dispatch resource check now uses per-queue free counts and no longer waits for IssuePushRes.done before dispatchEn, avoiding a 0-dispatch circular handshake.
Payload pop ports widened to ISSUE_WIDTH.
Payload depth widened to distributed queue payload space and pop loop widened to ISSUE_WIDTH.
IS->RR payload widened to ISSUE_WIDTH.
IssueStage now merges Int/Mem/Mul pop results into five issue slots.
PRF read and WB/bypass port counts now derive from ISSUE_WIDTH/WB_PORT_NUM.
RR->EX pipe arrays split into Int/Mem/Mul widths.
ReadRegStage reads five issue slots and packs them into execution pipe arrays.
EX->WB pipe arrays widened according to execution completion widths.
ALU execution lanes widened to INT_ISSUE_WIDTH.
BRC execution lanes widened to INT_ISSUE_WIDTH.
SYS execution lanes widened to INT_ISSUE_WIDTH.
MEM issue input narrowed to MEM_ISSUE_WIDTH while preserving MEM_WB_WIDTH completion ports.
MUL/DIV issue and completion path narrowed to one lane.
WB aggregation now emits WB_PORT_NUM done/wakeup/bypass/write ports.
ROB done ports now use WB_PORT_NUM.
ROB done scan loop now uses WB_PORT_NUM.
Issue width sampling now scans ISSUE_WIDTH slots; w2 remains saturated for width >= 2.
Documented distributed IssueQueue architecture and execution width changes.
Added implementation record, boundaries, and verification recommendations.

notes: Initial rv32 timeout was caused by DispatchStage waiting for IssuePushRes.done while IssuePushReq.valid was gated by dispatchEn. The fix removes IssuePushRes.done from the pre-dispatch resourceReady path and relies on per-queue free counts for IQ capacity. RV32MI/RV32I/RV32M now pass; remaining rv32uzb* failures are bitmanip-extension tests outside the distributed IssueQueue acceptance target.
